scope: Portable collector/integration qualification and offline ingestion of unchanged native 0.0.152 player replies. No new native performance or reliability run.

recording.full_collection_snapshot: At finalization, outside measured play; no growing full-snapshot serialization on ordinary observations.
recording.budget_includes: Retained records, per-segment summaries and report metadata/counters; not caller indentation or transient Python process memory.
data_semantics: Absent field, explicit null, unsupported/invalid telemetry and valid measured integer zero remain distinct.
Same owner/device/sequence/sample time requires exact typed cached-value equality; only report time, age and sampling activity may change.
Save-load session changes retain the graphics observation segment. Terminal records are retained separately.
Sequence resets, backwards sample times, changed device or heap identity create explicit continuity boundaries; no unexposed native renderer-context identity is inferred.
Per-heap sampled ranges are not summed across contexts or relabeled resident, dedicated or peak VRAM.
Complete means no recording omissions, not measured availability. Inspect contract_ok, legacy_unavailable, usable_samples, error_counts and omission_reasons.

coverage: Unknown and zero estimates; valid full-width integers; unsupported/invalid states and missing field versus explicit null.
Cache mutation including boolean/integer type changes; first/last report metadata and duplicate counts.
Owner, device, heap and sequence discontinuities; session changes; terminal data.
Serialized byte/count bounds including summaries, explicit omissions/errors and detached evidence.
Default-off and opt-in Soak hooks use existing responses and requests; diagnostic errors preserve the original functional result.

offline_retained_native.missing_metadata_policy: Explicit nulls tagged incomplete; no fabricated process identities, timing or phase joins.

independent_source_review.scope: Frozen source/AST and bound-accounting review; not a new hardware run.

limits: Selected telemetry-shape and cache checks, not a full frozen native schema validator or adversarial OS security boundary.
The new recording path has not run during representative focused play; CPU/storage overhead is unmeasured.
Historical paused native reports do not supply fresh performance, physical-input, foreground or lifetime VRAM qualification.
Earlier foreground failures remain failed; no focus or acceptance predicate was relaxed.
No Alpha gate is closed by this instrumentation slice.
